text: Dorton is the first fork in the § 2-207 analysis. Its result depends on the precise conditional language and on distinguishing a new acceptance from confirmation of an earlier oral agreement.
sourceSummary: A form stating that acceptance was “subject to” its terms did not clearly make the transaction depend on the buyer’s assent to those terms. Whether its added arbitration clause entered the contracts required further findings.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
